purpose: First permitted confirmatory spectral test of the pre-existing 119 Hz hypothesis on real public HA10 hydrophone waveforms after instrument-response calibration. This is confirmatory only, never a blind discovery search.

public_analysis_interval_utc.reason: Overlap between confirmed public HA10 FDSN access and the published EA T-phase catalog interval.

arrival_model.warning: The broad window absorbs path-speed and source-location uncertainty; exact arrival picking is not tuned after viewing 119 Hz.

matched_noise_contract.contamination_exclusion: Reject a candidate noise window if any catalog event has a predicted HA10 arrival within plus_or_minus_600_s of that noise-window center.
matched_noise_contract.selection_order: Use offsets exactly in listed order; choose the first two uncontaminated in-range windows per station-event.

response_correction_contract.source: EarthScope StationXML for the exact IM.H10N1..EDH and IM.H10S2..EDH epoch
response_correction_contract.method: Evaluate complex instrument response on the Welch frequency grid and compute pressure_PSD = raw_counts_PSD / abs(response_counts_per_Pa)^2.
response_correction_contract.invalid_response_rule: Bins with non-finite or non-positive response amplitude are invalid and cannot be interpolated into the target statistic.
response_correction_contract.known_119_hz_response_warning: 119 Hz is approximately -50.9 dB relative to 10 Hz on these channels; correction strongly amplifies measurement noise.

predeclared_statistics.band_power: median PSD of all Welch bins whose centers fall inside the declared band
predeclared_statistics.raw_event_vs_noise_snr_db: 10*log10(raw target-band event power / median raw target-band power across the two matched noise windows)
predeclared_statistics.corrected_event_vs_noise_snr_db: 10*log10(response-corrected target-band event power / median corrected target-band power across the two matched noise windows)
predeclared_statistics.corrected_target_sideband_contrast_db: 10*log10(corrected target-band event power / median corrected event power across near_left and near_right bands)
predeclared_statistics.target_peak_frequency_hz: Frequency of maximum response-corrected PSD inside 118.75-119.25 Hz only
predeclared_statistics.control_band_scores: For each declared control band, compute the same event-vs-matched-noise SNR and event sideband-style contrast where applicable; no undeclared controls may be added after inspection.

claim_ceiling: Even a full PASS establishes only a repeatable response-corrected HA10 119-Hz feature in this public slice. It does not identify a source, structure, technology, Love-Edem target, or underwater pyramid.
